assets.prompt: Create a landscape 2:1 atlas of EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal SQUARE cells with generous opaque ivory paper gaps, NO lines, labels, text or frame. Use the reference ONLY for aesthetic: spare FLAT matte gouache, charcoal silhouettes with minimal face marks, ochre/umber/sage pigment masses, dry broken brush edges and paper grain. No cinematic realism, glossy render or photographic faces. These are illustrations of eight different early civilization decisions; distinct compositions, ordinary adult proportions, invented practical handwoven wraps, only handmade wood/stone/fiber/clay tools. Each activity fully inside its own cell with breathing room on every edge. TOP ROW left to right: 1 KNOW THE WORLD: three travelers at differing depths crossing an open ridge, foreground person indicates a far river bend, bundles and walking sticks, exploratory motion. 2 BUILD TO LAST: two adults lifting a timber upright into a modest earthen wall frame, another steadies a rope, no giant monument or advanced masonry. 3 BRING US TOGETHER: unequal opinions in an open council of four seated adults around an empty central mat, one speaking, one objecting with an open hand, no throne. 4 SEEK KNOWLEDGE: two observers examining small seed and mineral samples on flat stones, one comparing them by pointing, low angle from one side. BOTTOM ROW left to right: 5 BUILD STRENGTH: three spear bearers practicing together at a simple camp, one experienced adult correcting another's stance, no metal armor, heroic portrait or battle gore. 6 CREATE ABUNDANCE: people tending irregular small crop plots with wooden digging sticks, baskets nearby, land worked by hand. 7 CARE FOR PEOPLE: seated tired elder receiving water from an adult while a second adult adjusts a simple shade canopy, quiet attentive care, no medical temple or instruments. 8 TRADE AND CONNECT: two travelers exchange a small basket and wrapped bundle at a footpath crossing, another carries a load into the distance, no currency or busy modern market. Restrained layouts that read at 150 pixels; adults lean and physically ordinary, not polished models. Every scene on same warm ivory paper background, no dark footer; UI labels are added separately.

Create a landscape 3:2 atlas of EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal SQUARE cells with generous opaque ivory gaps and no drawn separators, labels, text, borders or UI. Match supplied STYLE reference: spare flat matte gouache, dry brush, charcoal human silhouettes with minimal face marks, broad ochre/umber/sage shapes on warm ivory paper, not photography or cinematic realism. Six distinct civic decisions from an early fictional human society, handmade wood/stone/fiber/clay only, normal adult bodies, no heroic beauty or modern ideologies' symbols. Each cell is a separately composed incident with entire action within its square. TOP LEFT: FOUND NEW HORIZONS, a family-sized party unloading carrying baskets beside freshly placed shelter poles on an unfamiliar riverbank, one adult studies the ground before placing a stake; transition and uncertainty, no grand city. TOP MIDDLE: RULE AND EXTRACT, a standing collector counts small stone tokens beside piles of grain baskets brought by two visibly tired working adults, an armed attendant stands apart; collector's downward gesture controls the exchange, unequal access to goods, no gore or theatrical villain. TOP RIGHT: CHOSEN PEOPLE, an inward-facing circle of three adults holding a simple unmarked shared cloth token at a low boundary of stones while a traveler stands outside at a distance; depict exclusion and solidarity, not real religious or national symbolism, no ethnic caricatures. BOTTOM LEFT: ENTRENCH A DYNASTY, an older authority figure hands a plain carved staff to a younger adult relative on a small raised wooden platform, two other adults wait below; inherited office, no crowns or medieval royalty. BOTTOM MIDDLE: RULE THROUGH FEAR, two standing spear-bearing guards block a narrow gap in a rough timber fence, a tense authority figure motions a small group to remain back; civilians keep distance and look down, visibly coercive stance, no torture, chains, violence or blood. BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE OFFICIAL TRUTH, one designated speaker stands beside a few upright stones gesturing with a rod while three listeners must face them in a formal row; a second adult's questioning hand is being quietly lowered by a steward; control of who may speak, not a magical ritual, no writing or books. Understated figures and social relationships must carry meaning, no labels. Distinct angles and compositions. These map to actual civic choices and do not assign morality to ancestry.
